items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: What about in those times when you'd work with Oma and Ramon and bands like that

ctx.x: Would you rather just play music or do something else? No, I'd rather just play music. Why?

Well, because I love it. And I enjoy it. But I wouldn't enjoy doing any other kind of work. What about in those times when you'd work with Oma and Ramon and bands like that, would you make any money to market anything? Well, it didn't appear like now. All you'd make was, uh, at them time, the prices was, uh, I think about just about a dollar an hour. You'd pay a five-hour charge, you'd make five hours. Well, with that five hours, could you buy as much then as you buy with your day's salary at the paddock now? Uh,…
But most of the fellas still have day jobs, most of the musicians kept other jobs too. Is that right?
